findings.note: The implementation declares the ship-time recheck mandatory but leaves it unmodified and supplies no Capability-derived fragment there. Consequently it cannot catch a Lite-ineligible Capability introduced or made relevant after intake, despite REQ-005/OQ-002 explicitly assigning that defense-in-depth purpose to the second stage.

The defense-in-depth fixture proves only that the legacy keyword scanner later detects an unrelated `secret` keyword. It does not exercise ship-time Capability matching or a capability-reasons fragment, so it cannot verify the required later detection of an ineligible Capability missed at intake.

The functional test replaces the specified A2 `evaluate-predicate` fan-out with component-name equality even though the bundled repository history states that evaluator has landed. Static substring checks plus this surrogate do not verify the actual Capability × component invocation, result interpretation, or failure propagation described by REQ-005.
